Subject: Potential MAP + POC timeline (API keys, org setup, peering)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — CardioMetrics is excited to validate Redwood for real-time report generation in our clinician UX. We want to propose a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can hit a target close in 6 weeks. High-level asks to include in the MAP / evaluation run:
- Org bootstrap (tenant + role scaffolding) with a sandbox org we can use for dev testing
- API keys / ephemeral tokens for CI and for the QA team
- IP allowlist entries (we'll provide CIDR ranges) and VPC peering for production-like throughput tests
- A quick checklist for data retention/audit toggles we need to confirm for our compliance team

Can you send a MAP draft with milestone dates and owners? We can sign and return — goal is to start active tests the week of Oct 5.

Samantha (cc) and I will own the evaluation from CardioMetrics.

Best,
Alicia

Hi Alicia — great to meet you both. Attached is a one-page MAP draft that lays out milestones, owners, and a proposed close path that aligns with your Oct 5 start target. High-level timeline inside:

Milestones (proposed):
1) Org & tenant bootstrap (Redwood) — deliver sandbox org, initial roles, and test users — target: 2026-10-01 — owner: soojin_lee
2) API key provisioning (ephemeral tokens + CI integration guide) — target: 2026-10-02 — owner: jordan_blake
3) IP allowlist & VPC peering kickoff (network requirements intake) — target: 2026-10-03 — owner: marissa_cole
4) Performance smoke tests (10k tokens/min sustained) — 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-09 — owner: CardioMetrics/Samantha
5) Iterate on config (batching/quant profiles) and sign-off — 2026-10-12 — owner: joint

I've attached CardioMetrics_MAP_v1.1.pdf and a network intake spreadsheet for your team to populate. Please review and tell us any must-have changes. If that timeline looks good, we can lock dates and kickoff the peering intake on Oct 1.

Thanks —
Soojin

Subject: Re: ACTION: CardioMetrics MAP owners — org, keys, peering (see thread)

Quick network notes — copied from our intake template:
- For sandbox peering we generally prefer one of two flows: (A) IP allowlist (CardioMetrics outbound to Redwood public endpoints) for quick smoke tests, or (B) full VPC peering for throughput/latency parity testing.
- CardioMetrics should fill the attached poe-network-requirements.xlsx and indicate whether they can accept a managed NAT egress or will provide static IPs.
- If they choose VPC peering we need: account/project IDs, CIDR proposals (no overlap), allowed ports (443 + optional 10000-10010 for internal telemetry), and expected traffic profile. Peering SLA lead time: 5 business days once info is complete.

Recommendation: start with allowlist for Oct 5 smoke tests (fast), then escalate to peering for the perf window Oct 6–9 as a follow-up action. This matches the MAP milestones.

I'll set up a short intake call with CardioMetrics on Oct 1 to collect fields — can everyone join 2026-10-01T10:00 PT?

Marissa
